evals.name: first_publication_bootstrap
evals.prompt: Configure Trusted Publishing and publish this new npm package for the first time.
expect: Checks whether the package exists and whether npm permits trust before the first publication
Validates the exact tarball before bootstrap publication
Requests authorization for the exact live publish command

evals.name: multi_registry_preflight
evals.prompt: Release the JavaScript and Python packages from this repository together.
expect: Uses the publishing workflow for each registry
Derives versions from one approved release identity
Completes preflight for every package file before any publisher runs

evals.name: partial_registry_failure
evals.prompt: npm accepted the release, but the second registry failed.
expect: Preserves the successful immutable npm release
Retries only the failed publisher with the exact files from preflight
Does not rebuild or republish the successful version
